notes.title: 0.1.10.alpha
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
[*] Added new properties: Hotdog Stand, Lemonade Stand and Fruits Farm 
[*] Added meat factory has animation
[*] Updated Vegetables Farm with new visuals
[*] Added minimap
[*] Added Tab key as a shortcut to changing bridge level
[*] Added in-game time control 
[*] Added factory option to change produced ingredients
[*] Added quick stats to individual shops (sold and profits) & factories (production) 
[*] Added a graph to show overall profits and production (WIP)
[*] Added localization system
[*] Added research tree logic
[*] Added tooltip

[*] Updated HUD
[*] Updated many UI items (colors, font, and more)
[*] Updated Burger Place interior

[*] Fixed shops particle effects
[*] Fixed shop & factory's outlines
[*] Fixed multiplayer related bugs
[*] Fixed logistics accepting negative amount causing cheating way to get ingredients
[*] Fixed pedestrians (again)
[*] Fixed player control is enabled when inputting text

[*] Refactored shop logic from their visuals
[/list]
